pharmacology.text: AM-679 (part of the AM cannabinoid series) is a drug that acts as a moderately potent agonist for the cannabinoid receptors, with a Ki of 13.5 nM at CB1 and 49.5 nM at CB2.

uses.text: AM-679 was one of the first 3-(2-iodobenzoyl)indole derivatives that was found to have significant cannabinoid receptor affinity, and while AM-679 itself has only modest affinity for these receptors, it was subsequently used as a base to develop several more specialised cannabinoid ligands that are now widely used in research, including the potent CB1 agonists AM-694 and AM-2233, and the selective CB2 agonist AM-1241.

sideEffects.en: It has not been studied in people. Drugs of its class, the synthetic cannabinoids, can cause a racing heart, agitation, vomiting, confusion, seizures and psychosis.
sideEffects.zh: 它未曾在人體研究過。同類的合成大麻素可能造成心跳急促、躁動、嘔吐、混亂、癲癇發作與精神病。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它未曾在人体研究过。同类的合成大麻素可能造成心跳急促、躁动、呕吐、混乱、癫痫发作与精神病。

fact.en: AM-679 was one of the first compounds to show that putting an iodine atom on the benzoyl ring of an indole could make it bind cannabinoid receptors, which opened up a whole branch of this chemistry.
fact.zh: AM-679 是最早證明在吲哚的苯醯基環上接一個碘原子就能使其結合大麻素受體的化合物之一，這項發現開啟了這類化學的一整個分支。
fact.zhHans: AM-679 是最早证明在吲哚的苯酰基环上接一个碘原子就能使其结合大麻素受体的化合物之一，这项发现打开了这类化学的一整个分支。
